verdict.rationale: Tailscale's own MagicDNS automatically registers device names across the tailnet (docs-30), and users report reaching hosts by name from any device (comm-13). In effect, every device sees the same centrally coordinated set of hosts. Nothing in the evidence describes syncing user-saved hosts or per-device connection settings, and nothing covers offline behaviour. missing for 10: explicit sync of saved hosts and connection preferences, offline sync behaviour, first-party docs on settings sync, independent corroboration.
